title: When god answered what you truly wanted (unselfish)
content: My little nephew passed away at the age of thirteen due to cancer. The strongest person I have ever known till this day! He never complained and he never whined to us but I know he was experiencing a lot of pain. One day after school which I was going to school to be a certified A&P Technician. I arrived back home with two nurses at my home asking me who I was and where I was coming from, so I replied and went to bed. My mother minutes later after I was lying in bed came in to my room and let me know that my nephew had just passed. I got up and walked in with tears and sorrow to my little nephew’s bedroom. My everything was down, my everything was down! I went to bed grieving and asked god for 1 thing, if I can give my little nephew a hug one last time. Like a Christmas movie came down in a beam of light while I was asleep and woke up to see appeared in front of me. He tried to tell me something but I couldn’t hear him, no sound and I couldn’t read the lips. Everything was real to me but god gave me a chance to say goodbye to my nephew. I don’t sleep walk, but when I woke up if that was a dream, I was hugging the air. My true story to give people an understanding that he is there and he is listening. Thank you for giving the time to read this and thank you god for everything Amen!
